content: व्यवसायः .²1 Effort, exertion, energy, industry, perseverance; करोतु नाम नीतिज्ञो व्यवसायमितस्ततः <ls>H. 2. 14</ls>. .²2 Resolve, resolution, determination; मन्दीचकार मरणव्यवसायबुद्धिम् <ls>Ku. 4. 45</ls> ‘the thought of resolving to die’; व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः <ls>Bg. 2. 41</ls>; व्यवसायोऽस्मि <ls n="Bg.">10. 36</ls>. .²3 An act, action, performance; व्यवसायः प्रतिपत्तिनिष्ठुरः <ls>R. 8. 65</ls>. .²4 .³({%a%}) Business, employment, trade. .³({%b%}) Following a particular profession or trade. .²5 Conduct, behaviour. .²6 Device, stratagem, artifice. .²7 Boasting. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²9 Of Śiva. .²10 State, condition.
